projects.name: Enhanced Ballistics
projects.effect: Unlocks the item Alloy Enhanced Rounds [Increases ballistic/gauss damage by 1 and pen by 5]. We believe we can upgrade our ballistic small arms through combining alien materials with our own technologies.

projects.name: Alien Grenades
projects.effect: Allows the use of Alien Grenades and grants AP and HE grenades +1 damage. We've had a look at an intact alien grenade you recovered, and with a small investment of resources and time we believe that we can upgrade some of our current grenades to this new, deadlier version. We should also be able to apply some alloy shards to our current stock of HE and AP grenades, rendering them more lethal.

projects.name: Improved Medikit
projects.effect: Increases max HP of medikit healing by 2. The flexible physiology and behavioural analysis of the Elite Muton has given us new ideas for improving our Medikits. We now believe we can increase the amount of healing delivered in a single charge for medikits.

projects.name: Elerium Batteries
projects.effect: Increases the stun rate of the Stun Rifle and grants an additional charge to our Arc Weapons (Stun Rifle, Arc Rifle, Arc Pistol) and the Motion Tracker. Advances in Elerium have lead to batteries that can store and disperse much more energy. The new batteries should improve the capacities of our arc weapons and devices.

projects.name: Advanced Repair
projects.effect: Reduces aircraft, SHIV, and MEC repair times by 35%. As our understanding of alien materials grows, we believe that we can develop processes that would reduce the repair times of our fighter craft, SHIVs, and MECs.

projects.name: Enhanced Lasers
projects.effect: Unlocks the item Enhanced Beam Optics [increases beam/pulse laser damage by 1 and aim/crit by 5]. Now that we can produce high output laser weapons, we believe we can develop equipment to improve those weapons.

projects.name: Condensed Plasma
projects.effect: Unlocks Plasma Grenades and the Plasma Stellerator. Now that we understand the challenges of controlling plasma, we should be able to develop enhancements through investigating various plasma confinement ideas.

projects.name: SHIV Advancements III
projects.effect: Unlocks the final 2 levels of SHIV perks: [Critical System Targeting, Fortified, and Absorption Fields] and [Vital Point Targeting, Bring 'Em On, and Smart Macrophages].

projects.name: Advanced Scavenging
projects.effect: Studying the alien materials we have recovered has opened up the opportunity to send additional scavenging teams to captured UFOs. For a cost, these teams can attain additional resources from the UFO.

projects.name: Ammo Conservation
projects.effect: Increases the ammo capacity of primary shotguns, carbines, assault rifles, SMGs, and battle rifles by 1 shot/burst. Muton Elite armor contains servomotors that function as automatic weapon loaders, allowing their weapons to carry more ammunition without requiring the soldier to pause for a full reload. We could apply some of the same techniques to some of our own weapons.

projects.name: Advanced Flight
projects.effect: Doubles the fuel capacity of flight-capable units. We believe that we can improve the small system flight capabilities of our flying armor and the Hover SHIV designs, considerably increasing their maximum flight time in combat.

projects.name: Armored Fighters
projects.effect: Increases interceptor and firestorm HP by 30%. We have learned techniques to convert alien alloys into thin, malleable sheets that we can apply to all of our fighter aircraft without reducing their performance. These should give our aircraft significantly more durability in combat.

projects.name: High-Capacity Pistols
projects.effect: Grants +1 ammo to pistols. The alien alloys allow for the production of thinner magazine componentry which enables us to increase their ammo capacities. This upgrade will increase the number of shots we can fire from our sidearms before requiring a reload. In order to uncover this technology we will need to acquire many fragments of the alien weaponry for study. Does not affect arc pistols.

projects.name: Rail Pistols
projects.effect: Grants +5 aim to all pistols. We've started testing an experimental cryogenic treatment for the barrels of our existing sidearm designs. This process will greatly reduce heat distortions caused by repeated firing, which should increase the aim of all soldiers using a pistol.

projects.name: Reflex Pistols
projects.effect: Grants +10 crit to all pistols. Having learned a great deal from the alien weapons recovered from the field, we think it should be possible to implement improvements across our entire range of side arms. At the very least, we can expect our pistols to find weak points far more often.

projects.name: SHIV Advancements I
projects.effect: Unlocks the second level of SHIV perks: [Holo Rounds, Shredder, and Damage Control].

projects.name: Stealth Satellites
projects.effect: Decreases the success chance of UFO hunting missions by 50%. By studying the communication signatures of the UFO nav computers we've recovered, we could update our satellite network to mimic the alien communications. This would make the satellites much harder to detect if the aliens were to go looking for them.

projects.name: Beam Strengthening
projects.effect: Grants +15% crit damage during critical hits to all primary laser and pulse weapons. We can increase the impact of our laser and pulse weapons by injecting highly excited plasma into the beam chamber prior to the beams entering. The result is the output of a more energetic beam that can deal more damage to enemy weak spots.

projects.name: Jellied Elerium
projects.effect: Increases the damage of explosives by 1, increases flamethrower panic rolls by 30, and unlocks the Incinerator Amp. We can develop a more energetic state of Elerium: Jellied Elerium. This should allow us to improve the effectiveness of our rockets and flamethrowers.

projects.name: Heavy Shells
projects.effect: Grants all MECs HEAT Warheads (Explosives gain +40 penetration). Now, our MECs will be able to deploy explosives with larger payload designed to combat the ever increasing armor of the aliens. The large payloads contain highly explosive elerium shells which will penetrate even the most dense armor.

projects.name: Advanced Servomotors
projects.effect: Unlocks Walker Servos for soldiers and Elerium Turbos for SHIVs. We have some designs for gear that will improve mobility for our soldiers and SHIVs, although they may require we understand some other technologies first.

projects.name: Shaped Armor
projects.effect: Increases HP of mechanized units (SHIV, MEC) by 3 and KSM penetration by +20. The invaders' mechanized cybersuits are of course somewhat more advanced than our own; by examining the interfaces between the armored shells and the cores, we could improve our overall armor design.

projects.name: SHIV Advancements II
projects.effect: Unlocks the third level of SHIV perks: [Reactive Targeting Sensors, Light 'Em Up, and Close Combat Specialist].

projects.name: Tactical Rigging
projects.effect: Grants one extra utility slot to biosoldier armors other than Phalanx and the Leather Jacket (max 4). Increasing need for tactical flexibility has driven us to develop tactical rigs that apply to most of XCOM's individual soldier protection systems. These will enable soldiers to bring additional equipment into battle.

projects.name: Alien Metallurgy
projects.effect: Increases alien alloy recovery from missions and destroyed UFOs by 20%. Now that we have some understanding of these wonderous alien materials, we believe we can use Meld to develop techniques to extract additional alien alloys from what our salvage teams bring back from ground missions and UFO debris fields.

projects.name: Aircraft Boosters
projects.effect: Allows production of one-time 'boosters' for interception. Our initial investigation into alien materials have given us some ideas to build some one-time 'boosters' for our combat aircraft.

projects.name: Aegis Initiative
projects.effect: Reinforces XCOM Base patrol positions with cutting-edge defense strategies. Half or more of attacking aliens will have their HP reduced by an average of 1.5% per soldier on patrol (max 20 soldiers on patrol) due to advanced training, fortifications, and equipment. Reduces fatigue and injuries by 90% for patrol teams, as they defend from fortified locations, damaging aliens before they can retaliate. Further improves recruitment pipelines, lowering soldier recruitment time by an additional 3 days.

projects.name: Cooling Coils
projects.effect: Increases the rate of fire of all air weapons by 30%. We've noticed that some alien combat robots use advanced cooling coils to dissipate heat in their weaponry allowing for higher rates of fire. We believe we can incoporate these into our own aircraft weapon systems.

projects.name: Mechanized Defenses
projects.effect: Unlocks the Alloy Carbide Plating item (and with Advanced Power Armor, the Core Plating item) for MECs and SHIVs to increase their defensive capabilities. Our engineers have proposed some new systems that should increase mechanized unit survivability in increasingly dangerous battlefields.

projects.name: Advanced Surgery
projects.effect: Decreases biosoldier injury times by 25%. We think we can adapt some of the aliens' biological research systems into designs that will aid the rapid healing of our personnel.

projects.name: Improved Avionics
projects.effect: Increases aircraft aim by 10. Based on our analysis of UFO behavior, we think we've identified some signatures that our aircraft can track when in weapons range. We believe we can improve all our aircraft weapons' accuracy.

projects.name: UFO Countermeasures
projects.effect: Increases aircraft dodge by 10. Now that we have a handle on alien weapon systems and computers, we believe we can develop some countermeasures that will make our aircraft significantly harder to hit by alien UFO weaponry.

projects.name: Elerium Afterburners
projects.effect: Increases aircraft battle speed by 10. By directly injecting an Elerium particle stream into the exhaust of our aircraft engines, we can give short bursts of speed that will increase our engagement times with alien craft.

projects.name: Supercapacitors
projects.effect: Increases laser cannon damage from 400 to 800 damage [Potential: 240dmg/s, Average Realized: 144dmg/s] and unlocks Reaper Ammo. By increasing our ability to store energy, we can make some of our weapons far more dangerous to our alien foe.

projects.name: UFO Tracking
projects.effect: Increase interception time by 10%. Also increases the chance of aircraft detecting UFOs without satellites present (mimicking patrol behavior) from 7% per aircraft to 14% per aircraft. We've studied the enemy UFOs to the point that we believe we can improve our jets' ability to detect and track them at long ranges. Going forward with this project will double the chance of detecting UFOs with our aircraft on the same continent absent satellite coverage over a given country.

projects.name: MEC Warfare Systems
projects.effect: Vital for further MEC equipment development; prerequisite for the production of many advanced MEC weapons, suits, and items. Our engineering teams are proposing a number of exciting concepts to expand our MEC capabilities beyond that of a simple exoskeleton.

projects.name: Grey Market
projects.effect: Establishes a behind-the-scenes exchange for alien artifacts and military equipment to council nations to circumvent sanctions on illegal trade. An extra cargo compartment will allow Big Sky to make clandestine deliveries during down time. Desperate times call for desperate measures.

projects.name: Alien Nucleonics
projects.effect: Increases elerium recovery from missions and destroyed UFOs by 20%. Based on our studies of the alien power systems, we believe we can use meld to increase the efficiency by which we extract elerium from alien power sources and wrecks. Unfortunately, this will be a very resource-intensive project that threatens to deplete our stores of other artifacts.

projects.name: Improved Salvage
projects.effect: Increases weapon fragment recovery from missions and destroyed UFOs by 20%. As the demand for more and more alien materials grows, our engineers are proposing more precise techniques of using meld to repair battlefield debris and turn it into salvageable items. We believe we can increase the number of weapon fragments recovered after combat.

projects.name: New Combat Systems
projects.effect: Unlocks an array of new gear options in combination with other technologies and projects. Some of our troops are asking for specialized equipment to combat the alien threat. We believe we can produce some new accessories to increase their effectiveness on the battlefield.

projects.name: Psi Warfare Systems
projects.effect: Unlocks an assortment of psionic special equipment. Our breakthroughs in human psionics can extend beyond the realm of the mind alone. With your go-ahead, we can begin development of several specialized pieces of gear that can enhance our psi troopers battlefield capabilities.

projects.name: Operation Rapid Forge
projects.effect: Refines recruitment logistics to bring new soldiers on board faster. Lowers recruitment time by 3 days. Establishes patrol routes staffed by all idle (non-fatigued, non-injured, etc.) soldiers not actively selected to defend the base. These patrols weaken half or more of alien attackers, reducing their HP by an average of 0.5% per soldier on patrol (max 20 soldiers on patrol).

projects.name: Project Iron Resolve
projects.effect: Enhances XCOM Base patrol tactics and defensive readiness while streamlining recruitment efforts. Reduces recruitment time by an additional 3 days. Defensive outposts along patrol routes allow soldiers to engage alien forces more efficiently, reducing fatigue and injuries sustained by patrolling soldiers during an alien assault by 30% and increasing the HP reduction on half or more of alien attackers to an average of 1% per soldier on patrol (max 20 soldiers on patrol).

projects.name: Phoenix Coilguns
projects.effect: Upgrades phoenix cannon to Tier 3 penetration (from Tier 2). We believe we can significantly upgrade our Phoenix Cannon into advanced coilgun designs, significantly increasing its armor-piercing capabilities.

projects.name: UFO Scanners
projects.effect: Increase interception time by 10% and add UFO HP estimates to the interception screen. Our ongoing studies of the alien UFO types has led us to develop some ideas on how we can give our pilots precise information on alien UFO classes. With your approval, we can install air combat scanners on all our current and future combat aircraft that will help determine how much damage a UFO has sustained and help us maintain pursuit.

projects.name: Quenchguns
projects.effect: Grants +10 penetration to all primary ballistic and gauss weapons and upgrades the weapon damage of the sawed-off shotgun to 9 (from 6). By adding superconductors with magnetic fields to our ballistic and gauss arsenal we believe we can increase their armor-piercing capabilities.
